title: folio:cymatica — a vector arcade cabinet on the v99 engine, builds to web (today) and tauri (planned)
note: DRAFT 2026-11-20 (crew:wr-devpages-refactor:10), not yet in the cymatica repo. Cymatica disguises a standing-wave apparatus as a vector arcade game (docs/DEVELOPER.md:3). Game code lives in the engines/v99 submodule (cymatica branch); this repo holds lore, research, a companion server and earlier prototypes. Team membership is NOT here: it lives in pbase folio-members/<folio-id>.json. Build recipes are cited from engines/v99/package.json and engines/v99/tsm/env.toml; anything marked planned does not exist yet.

tauri.note: planned: no tauri.conf.json or Cargo.toml exists. v99 ships electron (engines/v99/electron) and capacitor/iOS (engines/v99/capacitor) targets instead.

targets.note: targets keep the existing schema shape (web, tauri, note; each {enabled}); the richer per-surface description is in surfaces below

dev.cite: engines/v99/package.json scripts.dev-browser; tsm form engines/v99/tsm/env.toml [local-dev] (vite, port 5173+, no --open)

build.cite: engines/v99/package.json scripts.build-browser -> `npm run build --prefix ./browser` -> vite build (browser/package.json)
build.output: engines/v99/browser/ (vite outDir not set in browser/vite.config.js; actual dist dir unverified, not built)

tauri.note: nothing exists. The web build above is the likely webview payload; the tauri shell (src-tauri, tauri.conf.json) must be created. Existing non-tauri native paths: electron (build-mac, build-mac-intel, build-windows) and capacitor iOS (build-ios, build-ios-release), engines/v99/package.json scripts.

editable.note: hint for devpages: what the editor pane may open. Nothing outside these is offered; submodule paths are edited in their own repo.

manifests.note: game.toml stays the game's identity/catalog manifest (slug, name, version, entry, features). folio.json says what the REPO is and how it builds; it does not copy game.toml fields.
